data.title: Payment reminder: returned direct debit, gym fee November 2025
data.summary: MusterFit Studios GmbH sent a reminder (Mahnung) dated 1 December 2025 because the direct debit for the November 2025 membership fee was returned. The total due is €47.40, to be paid by 12 December 2025.
data.explanation: Your bank returned the direct debit for your November 2025 gym membership fee (€39.90). The gym added a €7.50 fee for the bank's returned-debit charge, so the total is €47.40. Please transfer this amount to the account shown by 12 December 2025. If you already paid, you can treat the letter as settled. Check that your account had enough money and that your bank details are correct, so future debits don't fail. If you think the fee is wrong, contact the gym.
